scope: API Prometheus exposition of durable order-group lifecycle counts

assertions: the durable active OCO is counted by account, venue, and status
the durable ReconcileRequired OCO is separately visible
corrupt order-group storage produces metrics_available=0 without a zero-count status sample
the configured API /metrics route includes the order-group metrics availability gauge
the aggregate covers 373 named checks without duplicates

limitations: Metrics are derived from the local durable order-group store at scrape time; they do not measure exchange connectivity, venue latency, or remote state freshness.
No Binance, OKX, or Bitget API request was made, and no connector maturity status changed.
